elements.requirement: Every house in multiple occupation (HMO) to which Part 2 applies must be licensed under Part 2 unless a statutory exception applies.
elements.quote: Every HMO to which this Part applies must be licensed under this Part unless—

elements.requirement: An HMO to which Part 2 applies is exempt from the licensing requirement if a temporary exemption notice is in force in relation to it under section 62.
elements.quote: a temporary exemption notice is in force in relation to it under section 62

elements.requirement: An HMO to which Part 2 applies is exempt from the licensing requirement if an interim or final management order is in force in relation to it under Chapter 1 of Part 4.
elements.quote: an interim or final management order is in force in relation to it under Chapter 1 of Part 4

elements.requirement: A licence under Part 2 authorises occupation of the house concerned by not more than a maximum number of households or persons specified in the licence.
elements.quote: A licence under this Part is a licence authorising occupation of the house concerned by not more than a maximum number of households or persons specified in the licence.

elements.requirement: Applications for licences, the granting or refusal of licences, and the imposition of licence conditions are dealt with under sections 63 to 67.
elements.quote: Sections63 to 67 deal with applications for licences, the granting or refusal of licences and the imposition of licence conditions.

elements.requirement: The local housing authority must take all reasonable steps to secure that licence applications are made to them for any HMOs in their area that are required to be licensed under Part 2 but are not licensed.
elements.quote: The local housing authority must take all reasonable steps to secure that applications for licences are made to them in respect of HMOs in their area which are required to be licensed under this Part but are not.

elements.requirement: The appropriate national authority may make regulations providing for any provision of Part 2, or section 263 in its operation for such purposes, to apply to a section 257 HMO with modifications prescribed by the regulations.
elements.quote: The appropriate national authority may by regulations provide for— (a) any provision of this Part, or (b) section 263 (in its operation for the purposes of any such provision)

elements.requirement: Throughout Part 2, unless the context otherwise requires, references to a licence mean a licence under Part 2.
elements.quote: references to a licence are to a licence under this Part

elements.requirement: Throughout Part 2, unless the context otherwise requires, references to a licence holder must be read as referring to the holder of a licence under Part 2.
elements.quote: references to a licence holder are to be read accordingly

elements.requirement: Throughout Part 2, unless the context otherwise requires, references to an HMO being or not being licensed mean an HMO in respect of which a licence under Part 2 is or is not in force.
elements.quote: references to an HMO being (or not being) licensed under this Part are to its being (or not being) an HMO in respect of which a licence is in force under this Part.

elements.requirement: A section 257 HMO is defined as an HMO that is a converted block of flats to which section 257 applies.
elements.quote: A “section 257 HMO” is an HMO which is a converted block of flats to which section 257 applies.
